The campground is situated along Shell Creek and is close to the Adelaide Trailhead'; reservable via recreation.gov/877-444-6777; 'Seasons of Use Memorial Day - Labor Day, weather dependent'; '14 day stay limit'; 'Single Site: $20 per night'; 'Limit 8 people per site.'; 'Two non-towed vehicles allowed per site ... the second vehicle will be charged an extra fee'; Medicine Wheel Ranger District (307) 548-5304; point 44.55192431,-107.5186202; 'From Shell, WY, travel east on Hwy 14 for about 17 miles. https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233918 (API read 2026-11-20): concessionaire Rustic Freedom / Gallatin Canyon Campgrounds; 'For facility specific information, please call (307) 431-7446.'; 'Accessible vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection are provided. recreation.gov campsite catalog 233918 (2026-11-20): 14 sites (01-04, 06-15; no 05) - 12 STANDARD NONELECTRIC (RV/Trailer/Fifth Wheel permitted; RV max 30-75 ft, driveways 30-78 ft; 04 and 09 pull-through) and 2 TENT ONLY (07, 08); site 09 the only standard site not reservable online; no electric, water or sewer attributes

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 with the catalog's site points: the loop runs along the bench north of a forested strip; Shell Creek is under that canopy south of the sites (not visible); stored pin ~30 m from the site centroid 44.55049,-107.51473

booking.source: recreation.gov facility 233918 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14; 11 of 12 standard sites reservable online) + FS page ('14 day stay limit'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: Memorial Day to Labor Day per the Forest Service, weather dependent; recreation.gov sells sites into late September. Gated after closing.

season.source: recreation.gov 2026 peak season 2026-05-22..2026-09-21; FS page ('Memorial Day - Labor Day, weather dependent'; 'gated after season closures'), read 2026-11-20

values.note: 12 RV sites and 2 tent-only sites (7, 8); sites 4 and 9 are pull-throughs.

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.') + recreation.gov ('The nearest dump station is 19 miles away at Burgess Junction.'), read 2026-11-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog 233918 (every site STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC, no water/sewer hookup attributes), read 2026-11-20

values.note: One non-towed extra vehicle allowed, paid at the campground.

fees.source: recreation.gov rates 233918 (2026 peak $18.50) + notice ('the second vehicle will be charged an extra $10.00 fee at the campground'); FS page ('Limit 8 people per site.'), read 2026-11-20

note: Bighorn NF concessionaire campground on Shell Creek, 1.2 miles south of US-14 on FR 17 (Paintrock Lakes Road), about 17 miles east of Shell. Near the Adelaide Trailhead into the Cloud Peak Wilderness. No horses. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov + catalog read: 14 sites (12 RV, 2 tent-only 7/8; 4 and 9 pull-through; RV max 30-75 ft), reservable on rec.gov, $18.50 (+$10 second vehicle), 8 people, 14 days, vault toilets + water, no hookups, dump 19 mi. Season written from rec.gov 2026 (05-22..09-21). Count 15 -> 14. Unsourced 'rough access road' dropped. Phone empty -> (307) 548-5304. Pin fine. Not waterfront kept; creekside lead (canopy).
flags: FEES CONFLICT: FS page says 'Single Site: $20 per night'; recreation.gov sells $18.50 for 2026 (and lists $18.50 through 2028). Wrote rec.gov per the brief.
BOOKING: site 09 (standard, pull-through) is the only RV site not reservable online - possibly first-come or a management site; fcfs left unset.

NOTE: removed 'access road can be rough for big rigs' (no source on FS or rec.gov; neither mentions an access problem) and the spur/length prose now in sites; 'RVs to ~75 ft' is the catalog's longest site (13).
PHONE: empty -> (307) 548-5304 (FS Medicine Wheel Ranger District). The concessionaire line on rec.gov is (307) 431-7446.

WATERFRONT LEAD (not changed): both agencies say the campground is on the banks of Shell Creek; the creek runs under the forest canopy south of the sites and can't be seen on imagery, and it is well under 30 m wide - creekside at most. Left 'not waterfront' (canopy-blind).
